release: Guardian OS V9.2.1 Monitoring Continuity & UX Reliability
completed: Expanded Cross-Session Evidence / Why matched panels persist across live refreshes.
Floating live-monitoring preview appears on non-Monitoring pages while monitoring is active.
Floating preview supports expand, return-to-Monitoring, and hide-without-stopping-monitoring.
Back-to-top control added for long pages.
Monitoring/calibration fallback wording made less destructive/confusing.
important_calibration_note: The supplied patch does not contain the backend service that decides when quick profile verification falls back to a full calibration. Therefore this package does not weaken or alter that safety-critical fallback timing. The visible calibration messaging is improved, but changing the actual 3-second fallback requires the backend monitoring/calibration lifecycle service from the full project.
